visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video starts with a digital screen capture of mobile MOBA gameplay. Colorful avatars battle on a green field with health bars and damage numbers floating above. (2) The scene cuts to a live stage event where a group of young men in white, yellow, and navy team jerseys are seen from behind, jumping and embracing each other in celebration. The background is a brightly lit arena with massive digital screens. (3) A wide shot captures the team on a stage lifting a large golden trophy together. Gold confetti fills the air under bright, multicolored spotlights. (4) A multi-pane sequence shows the player focused at his desk above, the team hugging in the middle, and the trophy lift at the bottom. (5) A young man with dark hair, glasses, and a team jersey sits in a studio with a purple and blue gradient background. He speaks to the camera, using natural hand gestures. (6) The final shot is a static graphic featuring a portrait of the player, bold text, and various logos.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The video alternates between a digital game interface, a brightly lit professional esports arena with LED screens and confetti, and a controlled studio environment with a stylized blue and purple gradient background.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a steady, driving electronic beat accompanied by a calm, narrative male voice speaking in Mandarin. The music maintains a rhythmic pulse. (2) A sharp transition occurs with a sudden burst of loud, high-energy cheering and a second male voice (a commentator) shouting excitedly. The music increases in intensity and orchestral depth during this peak. (3) The original narrator returns, continuing his reflective talk while the energetic background track remains as a supportive bed. (4) The track ends with a final musical crescendo that punctuates the visual announcement.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as an official announcement for the re-signing of professional player Yuxiang with the Flash Wolves esports team. It builds emotional investment by showcasing his journey, past struggles, and recent championship victory before confirming his continued partnership with the brand.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Visible team jerseys and logos for Red Bull and local sponsors integrated into the content and final graphic.
